name: Numerical Error Analysis
description: Taylor-series evaluation, floating-point error, cancellation, convergence and reliability diagnostics.
safeModeNote: Uses the normal NumPy/mpmath scientific implementation; no fragile external physics engine is required.
fullModeNote: Same validated numerical solver today. Full mode is reserved for future external reference engines.

name: Ising Monte Carlo Lab
description: 1D/2D Ising systems, Monte Carlo samplers, critical behavior, uncertainty and convergence diagnostics.
safeModeNote: Uses NumPy/SciPy Monte Carlo directly; no fragile external physics engine is required.
fullModeNote: Same validated Ising solver today. No native external engine is required.

name: Random Walk & Monte Carlo
description: Random walks, Monte Carlo integration, QMC comparisons, uncertainty and reproducible ensemble studies.
safeModeNote: Uses the normal NumPy/SciPy/Matplotlib implementation; no fragile engine is required.
fullModeNote: Same validated stochastic solver today. No native external engine is required.

name: Nonlinear Dynamics & Chaos
description: Driven pendula, Kapitza stabilization, double pendula, Lyapunov divergence and flip maps.
safeModeNote: Uses NumPy/SciPy/mpmath directly; no fragile external physics engine is required.
fullModeNote: Same validated nonlinear solver today. No native external engine is required.

name: Oscillation & Integration
description: Linear, damped, driven and nonlinear oscillators with method comparison, convergence and energy-work checks.
safeModeNote: Uses the existing NumPy/SciPy oscillator and integration solvers; no fragile external engine is required.
fullModeNote: Same validated solver today. PyChrono is not forced into this model until a real comparison adapter is implemented.

name: RADIA Magnet Studio
description: 3-D magnet geometry, field solving, manufacturing errors, harmonics, trajectories and computational studies.
safeModeNote: Runs an analytical ideal-undulator fallback without importing RADIA. NumPy/SciPy/plotting packages remain allowed.
fullModeNote: Runs the full RADIA 3-D magnet geometry and field solver.

name: Radiation Platform
description: Unified magnet-to-trajectory-to-radiation workflow with scan-centric analysis and research visualization.
safeModeNote: Runs analytical undulator/radiation estimates without importing RADIA. It is a fallback, not a replacement for 3-D field solving.
fullModeNote: Runs the full magnet → trajectory → radiation workflow with RADIA.

name: Kerr Black Hole Geodesics
description: Strengthened Kerr geodesic workspace with massive and photon orbits, Carter-Mino integration, invariant residuals, verification campaigns and frequency-structure refinement.
safeModeNote: Uses the Kerr solver and verification UI bundled with this Physical Lab build; no second solver checkout is downloaded.
fullModeNote: Same bundled Kerr implementation today. Full mode does not silently substitute a different relativity engine.

name: Sun–Jupiter–Saturn Dynamics
description: Barycentric Sun-Jupiter-Saturn orbital dynamics with Newtonian baseline, bounded 1PN approximation, long-horizon diagnostics, verification workflow and 5:2 commensurability refinement.
safeModeNote: Uses the solar-system solver and verification UI bundled with this Physical Lab build; no second solver checkout is downloaded.
fullModeNote: Same bundled orbital implementation today. Optional model terms remain explicitly labeled approximations or phenomenological studies.

name: Multilayer Honeycomb Lattice
description: Reduced-unit multilayer honeycomb lattice dynamics with stacking, defects, strain, driven/Langevin studies, phonon dispersion, DOS and transport refinement.
safeModeNote: Uses the lattice dynamics and phonon implementation bundled with this Physical Lab build; no second solver checkout is downloaded.
fullModeNote: Same bundled reduced-unit lattice model today. It is not relabeled as an ab-initio or calibrated graphene solver.

name: RADIA Universal2 Runtime
description: Builds and verifies RADIA + FFTW as Universal2 for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

name: Chrono::Modal Universal2 Builder
description: Builds a relocatable Universal2 Project Chrono SDK with the Chrono::Modal component. Optional until a Lab consumes its provider.

name: VAMPIRE Apple Silicon Builder
description: Builds and smoke-tests the VAMPIRE atomistic magnetic simulator. Optional and currently Apple-Silicon-only.
